notes.title: Damage update #8
notes.content:
So, some of the players was frustrated with player damage system so I put it out. Now you can jump and run around without fear. Enjoy and check our daily streams. And yeah chack out Rest House 2 - The Wizard. Journey continues...

[previewyoutube=n-Qblscm-uw;full][/previewyoutube]

Stay safe and thank you for the support.

One man development team.

Your M.

notes.title: Don Quixote want You! RH update #6
notes.content:
-patch 6 fixed exe for VR it was pointing to older version before this fix
-more in game video UI and audio goals and story elements
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27756713/0fd364f813c0d9dc672e42f95dc102edff59a206.jpg[/img]

-multiplayer steam integration (you can see your avatar in the multiplayer level) when logged in Steam
-escape button is opening pause menu which is better (I think)
-new achievement! Who will find it first!
-finally VR free version but it is just the beginning

[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-mydJXoFBf8&list=PLW53bhYBSso8-eJPS00hbtOXQqBoQWdKN&index=5] RH game dev. daily stream playlist	[/url]

https://youtu.be/edIvdytCdHw?list=PLW53bhYBSso8-eJPS00hbtOXQqBoQWdKN
-and much more
-in this update I was struggling with many bug fixes and polishing witch you probably wont notice (is it good?) but I will continue this journey adding more Don Quixote elements and finally describe you a little bit more about the lore
-thank you for your support and keep it up because this game is just for you! 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27756713/8ded717cfd8c95a821d77aba07da40d55541e240.jpg[/img]

-what do you think what should be added or improved? Please let me know.
Type in the comments bellow.

notes.content:

-ue4 character default start fix (bug appeared out of nowhere)
-achievement 1 and 2 fix (now they should work for some time :))
